s: Ubo seip echad: lel sheni shel rosh hashshana shechal lihyot bemotzae shabbat omerim "vattodienu" qodem "vattitten lanu" kemo bishar yom tob shechal bemotzae shabbat, veap al pi shemmazkirin bo "chagigat haregel" verosh hashshana eno lo chag velo regel — en bekak kelum, mishshum deen hakkavvana shehayyom hu regel ella hu moneh seder hattiqqun hammattanot shennatan lanu haqqadosh baruk hu "qedushshat shabbat ukebod moed vachagigat haregel veku'". Umeqaddeshim yqnh"z kebishar yom tob shechal bemotzae shabbat:
